{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment to compare conversion rates within each segment
# Compute conversion rate within each segment
conversion_rates = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute average revenue per order within each segment and channel
avg_revenue = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().reset_index()

# Display results
print("Conversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_rates)

print("\nAverage revenue per order by channel and segment:")
print(avg_revenue)"}
